Q: Match exact word using grep A:

I know I'm a bit late but I found this question and thought of answering. A word is defined as a sequence of characters and separated by white-spaces. so I think this will work:
grep -E ' +test1|^test1' file.

This searches for lines which begin with test1 or lines which have test preceded by at least one white-space. sorry I could find a better way if someone can please correct me :)

Q: How can I "log in" to a website using Python's Requests module? A:

Some pages may require more than login and a password. There may even be hidden fields.

The most reliable way is to use an inspect tool and look at the network tab while logging in, to see what data is being passed on.

Q: MariaDB / PDO / PHP 1020 error ("Record has changed since last read in table") A:

Thanks for all the information in this thread... have updated my raspi, which did lead to installing version 11.8.3 of mariadb, and suddenly i got this errormessage from one of my python routines.

So rootcause found... but i am struggeling a little bit with a possible solution.

The error appears every few days and the log-file would be very big before catching the error... so one question for theory here:

The code which fails does only include reading of db's except one write to one record, which is followed immediately by a commit. How can this create such an error ?

Q: Diving into Embedded Linux A:

🐧 Diving into Embedded Linux

blockblastsolver

Embedded Linux is Linux customized to run on resource-constrained devices such as routers, smart TVs, IoT devices, industrial controllers, automotive systems, and medical equipment.

Unlike desktop Linux, embedded systems are:

  • Purpose-built

  • Often headless (no screen/keyboard)

  • Optimized for size, boot time, and reliability

🔹 Why Use Embedded Linux?

✔ Open source and highly customizable
✔ Huge hardware and community support
✔ Scalable (from small IoT devices to complex systems)
✔ Long-term maintainability
